pages.title: Tap a Living Tree
pages.text: Use a Resin Tap or primitive knife on a horizontal side of a supported living tree log. The adjacent space must be replaceable. Tapping costs one durability and places a Resin Scar. The tree must remain intact and living to support it.

pages.title: Harvest Again
pages.text: The scar grows through four visible ages on random ticks. At its final age, empty-hand right-click drops one Resin and resets its age. Leave the tree intact to repeat. Random-tick growth has no fixed stopwatch guarantee.

pages.title: Strong Bindings
pages.text: Resin, Charcoal Powder, and Twine make two Hafting Compound. Rope and Hafting Compound are strong bindings by default. They unlock the Stone Hammer, Bellows, Copper Knife, and stronger workshop construction.
